label: If the 65% rule had stayed
expectation: From mid-2026 no new gas or oil boilers: replacements go to heat pumps, biomass and, where available, district heating, so the fossil share falls much faster than under the Bio-Treppe

source.assumption: Counterfactual: GEG 2024 §§ 71–73 kept, so in cities above 100,000 inhabitants like Aachen new heating systems must use 65% renewable energy from 1 July 2026. Simplified as a ban on gas and oil boilers.
